instruction: A candid studio photograph captures a medium full shot of two women dancing against a plain beige wall. On the left, the woman with an afro in a brown button-up dress (R1) stands facing forward, smiling confidently at the camera while dancing. To her right, the woman with short brown hair in a striped shirt and white trousers (R2) is captured mid-motion, looking down and to the left as she moves energetically. The warm, diffused studio lighting highlights their expressive poses and the minimalist, clean aesthetic of the space.
